title: Grand Prix 5000 AS TR
notes: Official 700C table read 2026-11-01: 25-622 285 g black / 295 g cream, 28-622 320 g black / 330 g cream, 32-622 370 g black / 380 g cream, 35-622 415 g black / 425 g cream. Hooked/hookless maximum: 25 mm 109/73 psi, 28 mm 95/73 psi, 32 mm 73/65 psi, 35 mm 66/58 psi; rim ranges as for the S TR. Page: all-season tire built on the 5000 S TR with increased puncture protection and grip, 'Superior grip in all-weather conditions and thicker tread', reinforced sidewall, reflective strip (black), 'Tubeless Ready and hookless compatible'; Vectran Breaker, LazerGrip, ACT, Handmade in Germany, 2/220 TPI.
